description: An Astro site, deployed by every merge to main, so each Renovate PR is a deploy. Managers: npm (package.json and package-lock.json) and GitHub Actions. The workflows set Node in setup-node's node-version input, which no manager reads, so Node moves by hand. Lock-file refreshes stay off (the shared default): npm cannot hold a refresh to the 14-day wait.

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for the non-major npm updates, so the site gets at most one routine deploy a week from Renovate.
astro check needs TypeScript's programmatic compiler API, which TypeScript 7's native compiler does not expose (README, Develop).
